Looking at the thoughtful contributions across our panel, we have established total agreement on three foundational lore facts:

The remaining divide between 1 and 2 has been thoroughly clarified by our discussion, and the evidence points definitively to **2 years**:

#### 1. Why the "8 to 10 Month" Timeline Only Covers *Wings of Liberty*
The ~8–10 month figure that led several colleagues to consider 1 year actually applies **only to the campaign of *Wings of Liberty***—from the initial raid on Mar Sara (October 2504) to the climax of the invasion of Char and Kerrigan's de-infestation (mid-2505).
